what_this_pins: An action centre placed by clicking an element is a value CAPTURED at that click, not a quantity recomputed from the element's live vertices. It cannot move while a transform gesture runs.
The capture happens on the button-DOWN of a press that hits no tool handle. It is not scoped to a gesture: the captured point stays in force across later gestures until the next such click.

The per-frame transform reads SOURCE POSITIONS from the pre-gesture mesh, not from the previous frame's output. This holds independently of the action centre and is what makes any live-pivot scheme safe.
Neither behaviour depends on which transform bank is active: translate, rotate and scale all show it.

rig.description: 3 x 3 lattice of points in the ground plane, y = 0, spanning [-1.2, +1.2] in x and z; four quads wound so their normals point +y (toward the camera).

cases.name: element_centre_under_translate
cases.gesture: click one element to place the action centre, then drag to translate the whole mesh
cases.captured_centre_note: a point ON the picked element, not its midpoint: y is exactly the rig plane and z is exactly the rig's boundary row
cases.prediction_if_pivot_were_live: the pivot would travel the full 0.64 with the geometry and compound
cases.prediction_if_pivot_were_captured: one value for the whole gesture

cases.name: element_centre_under_translate_second_pick
cases.gesture: same, with the placing click on a different element
cases.role: positive control: the placement mechanism is alive, so the constancy above is a measurement and not a dead field

cases.name: element_centre_under_rotate
cases.role: the law is not specific to one transform bank

cases.name: element_centre_under_scale
cases.role: a scale about its own pivot is a FIXED POINT of that pivot, so this case cannot by itself separate a captured pivot from a live one. Kept as a consistency check only; the translate cases are the discriminator.

cases.name: source_positions_under_translate
cases.gesture: select two of the four quads, place the action centre at the SELECTION centroid (a quantity the engine recomputes from geometry every evaluation), then translate
cases.prediction_if_source_positions_were_the_: the published centroid climbs from -0.6 toward -0.05 across the gesture
cases.prediction_if_source_positions_are_the_p: one value, exactly the pre-gesture centroid
cases.why_the_selection_must_not_be_empty: with nothing selected and a rig centred on the origin the centre reads (0,0,0), which is both the centroid AND the empty-selection fallback — a constant that is constant for the wrong reason. Selecting a subset whose centroid is elsewhere is what makes this case informative.

unmeasured: The toggle that switches the captured point between the element's centre and the position clicked on it, and its default.
The same question in item mode and in a UV editing pane.
A tolerance: all constancy claims here are bit-identical at 9 decimal places, so no tolerance was needed.
